  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

Job Title: Billing Officer

Department: Finance & Accounts

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Billing Officer will be responsible for managing the company's billing and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of invoices, proper documentation, reconciliation of billing records, and coordination with internal departments and customers. The role requires strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and good knowledge of accounting and billing procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.
  • Assist in preparing billing-related MIS and periodic reports for management.
  • Handle customer queries related to invoices, billing adjustments, credit notes, and payment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, company policies, and internal control procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of financial and customer information.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to billing and receivables.
  • Identify billing errors or process gaps and recommend improvements where required.
  • Perform other finance and accounting duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or a related field.
  • 2â4 years of relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable.
  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and billing procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple invoices and deadlines efficiently.
  • Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ERP/accounting software such as Tally, SAP, Odoo, or similar systems.

  • Experience in handling high-volume billing operations.
  • Good understanding of sales, inventory, and accounts receivable processes.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Numerical & Analytical Ability
  • Time Management
  • Problem-Solving
  • Communication & Coordination
  • Accountability
  • Integrity & Confidentiality
  • Process Orientation
  • Teamwork

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of invoice generation
  • Billing error and discrepancy rate
  • Timely reconciliation of billing records
  • Resolution time for billing-related issues
  • Accuracy of billing MIS and documentation
  • Compliance with internal billing and financial procedures

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

Ready to Make an Impact?

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

title: Maintenance Planner
description:
Job Purpose

We are seeking a Maintenance Planner to join our Engineering Stores team. In this role, you will be responsible for effectively planning, preparing, and scheduling maintenance activities to support equipment reliability, maximize plant availability, and reduce unplanned downtime. You will work closely with the Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Spare Parts teams to ensure maintenance activities are prioritized, properly resourced, and executed safely and on time.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans, prepares, and schedules maintenance work orders to ensure they are completed safely, on time, and in full (OTIF).

  • Prepares work orders by defining the required scope, tasks, resources, materials, and tools.
  • Schedules maintenance activities considering equipment criticality, planned downtime windows, and availability of parts and services.
  • Coordinates with the Spare Parts Coordinator, Storekeeper, Procurement, and Maintenance Execution teams to ensure required materials and tools are available.
  • Manages maintenance task lists and ensures required materials are requested in line with inventory and supply processes.
  • Ensures accurate and timely registration and management of maintenance information within the CMMS.
  • Supports preventive maintenance planning and contributes to the preparation of maintenance budgets.
  • Supports TPM and continuous improvement activities to improve maintenance effectiveness, reliability, and plant availability.
  • Works closely with maintenance stakeholders to improve planning efficiency, reduce downtime, and support reliable execution of maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.

Knowledge & Experience:

  • 2â5 years of experience in maintenance planning, operations, supply chain, or a reliability-focused role.
  • Experience in maintenance planning, preparation, and scheduling.
  • Good understanding of supply and inventory management processes.
  • Experience working with a CMMS and/or maintenance planning and scheduling software.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to plan ahead and manage multiple priorities.

description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Infantry Soldiers are the Armyâs primary combat fighters and are responsible for closing with and destroying the enemy. They are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armour Soldiers.

Infantry Soldiers are capable of operating anywhere in the world in any environment â Arctic tundra, mountains, jungle or desert â and in any combination of arms, including airmobile and amphibious operations. The primary duties of Infantry Soldiers are to:

  • Expertly operate and maintain a wide range of weapons, including rifle, hand-grenades, light, medium and heavy machine-guns, and anti-tank weapons
  • Use sophisticated equipment for field communications, navigation and night-vision surveillance
  • Inspect and maintain weapon systems, vehicles, survival gear and personal defensive equipment
  • Participate in airborne operations
  • Operate with support elements such as fighter aircraft, tactical and artillery
  • Engage in unarmed combat
  • Employ camouflage and concealment, patrol, assault, defence, and escape-and-evasion tactics.


Work environment


Infantry Soldiers normally work outdoors. Both in training and on operations they live and work in conditions that would resemble those in the field. Infantry Soldiers will be posted to a battalion in Canada, but there are employment opportunities across Canada and on deployed operations around the world.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options

No previous work experience or career related skills are required. CAF recruiters can help you decide if your personal interests and attributes match the criteria for this occupation.

The minimum required education to apply for this occupation is the completion of the provincial requirements for Grade 10 or Secondary 4 in Quebec.

Foreign education may be accepted.

Training

The first stage of training is the Basic Military Qualification course, or Basic Training, held at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. This training provides the basic core skills and knowledge common to all trades. A goal of this course is to ensure that all recruits maintain the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) physical fitness standard; as a result, the training is physically demanding.

Infantry Soldiers attend one of three Military Training Centres: The Royal Canadian Regiment in Meaford, Ontario; Princess Patriciaâs Canadian Light Infantry in Wainwright, Alberta; and the Royal 22 e RÃ©giment in Valcartier, Quebec. The training takes 17 weeks and includes the following topics:

  • Use and care of personal and section-level weapons, including rifles, machine guns and anti-tank weapons
  • Field-craft, including personal hygiene and meal preparation, camouflage, sentry duties, signalling, selecting firing positions, tactical movements and lines of advance
  • Construction of field defences, such as trenches and roadblocks, and laying and marking of minefields
  • Navigation by day and by night
  • Patrolling operations
  • Infantry section and platoon tactics, including offensive, defensive and transitional operations

Infantry Soldiers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including:

  • Basic Parachutist
  • Parachute Jumpmaster
  • Para Instructor
  • Mountain Warfare
  • Instructional Techniques
  • First Aid Instructor
  • Rappelmaster
  • Nuclear, Biological and Chemical Defence Instructor
  • Urban Operations
  • Close Quarter Combat Instructor

As they progress in their career, Infantry Soldiers who demonstrate the required ability and potential will be offered advanced training. Available courses include:

  • Instructional Techniques
  • Primary Army Leadership
  • Infantry Section Commander
  • Infantry Platoon Second in Command
  • Infantry Company Sergeant-Major
  • Communicator
  • Reconnaissance Patrolling
  • Anti-Armour Gunner
  • Sniper
  • Machinegunner (Heavy and General Purpose)
  • Small Arms Coach
  • 25mm Gunner and light armoured vehicle Crew Commander
  • Winter (Arctic) and Jungle Operations
  • Patrol Pathfinder
  • Tactical Intelligence Operator

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at a Unit in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Infantry Soldiers serve with the Canadian Army. They are the Armyâs primary combat fighters, are responsible for engaging the enemy and are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armoured Soldiers. When they are employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve at a Forces Infantry unit located within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards. Following basic training, Infantry Soldiers attend one of three CAF training centres for 7 weeks of Infantry training.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. They are paid 92.8% of Regular Force rates of pay, receive a reasonable benefits package and may qualify to contribute to a pension plan.

description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Engineer Officers help the army live, move and fight. They are members of the Corps of Royal Canadian Engineers. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms.

The primary responsibility of Engineer Officers is combat readiness. Either working within Canada during an emergency or on international missions, Engineer Officers are responsible for:

  • Constructing habitable camps
  • Breaching minefields
  • Using explosives to destroy a road or bridge
  • Constructing a bridge or ferry
  • Building a combat road
  • Disposing explosives
  • Constructing obstacles


Work environment


Engineer Officers are employed at bases and stations across Canada and on deployed operations around the world. They experience the unique adventures and challenges that come with working in different environments and various terrains â Arctic tundra, tropical jungle, desert, mountains, urban complex â and various climates.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options
  • Paid Education Options

If you already have a university degree, the Forces will decide if your academic program matches the criteria for this job and may place you directly into the required on-the-job training program following basic training. Basic training and military officer qualification training are required before being assigned.

Regular Officer Training Plan

Due to the requirement for CAF officer to obtain a university degree, the CAF will pay successful recruits to complete a bachelor degree program in the Royal Military College System. Recruits will receive full-time salary including medical and dental care, as well as vacation time with full pay in exchange for working in the CAF for a period of time. Typically, candidates enter the Canadian Military College System as an Officer Cadet where they study subjects relevant to both their military and academic career. In rare instances, based on the needs of the CAF, candidates may be approved attend another Canadian University. A determination will be made on a case by case basis. If you are applying for this program, you must apply to the CAF and it is recommended to apply to other Canadian universities of your choice should you not be accepted for ROTP.

Training

After enrolment, you start basic officer training at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec, for 12 weeks. Topics covered include general military knowledge, the principles of leadership, regulations and customs of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF), basic weapons handling, and first aid. Opportunities will also be provided to apply such newly acquired military skills in training exercises involving force protection, field training, navigation and leadership. A rigorous physical fitness program is also a vital part of basic training. Basic officer training is provided in English or French and successful completion is a prerequisite for further training.

Following basic officer training, official second language training may be offered to you. Training could take from two to nine months to complete depending on your ability in your second language.

Common army phase

After basic training, you will go to the Infantry School at the Combat Training Centre in Gagetown, New Brunswick. You will build upon the leadership training you received in basic officer training in addition to learning the skills required of all Combat Arms Soldiers, including more advanced weapons-handling, field-craft, and section-level tactics.

Engineer Officers attend the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick. For the first two and a half months, training focuses on basic combat engineering skills and includes subjects such as:

  • Basic demolitions
  • Mine warfare
  • Obstacle construction
  • Field fortifications
  • Dismounted infantry tactics at the platoon level

It ends with a three-week field deployment where the Engineer Officerâs ability to lead a Troop is assessed. The final nine months of training concentrates on reconnaissance, planning, and Troop-level combat engineer tasks. Subjects included are:

  • Bridge building
  • Minefield construction
  • Booby-trap clearance
  • Route denial
  • Bridge demolition
  • Combat road repair and construction
  • Defensive works
  • Timber and rope field machines
  • Destruction of battlefield munitions
  • Construction of temporary camps
  • Breaching various obstacles in the face of the enemy

At the end of the last phase, during a comprehensive four-week field deployment, the skills acquired are assessed.

Engineer Officers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including after the first tour of duty with a first line unit, they may choose to specialize in one of the following areas:

  • Combat diving
  • Counter explosive threat
  • Mapping and geodesic support to joint operations
  • Infrastructure engineering to both garrison and deployed installations
  • Technical engineering to support the procurement and management of equipment

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at an Army Base or armoury in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Engineer Officers serve with the Canadian Army. Their primary responsibility is combat readiness â to help the army live, move and fight. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms team. Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. title: VP/Head of Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Volle technische Verantwortung für Rocket — direkt an die Gründer, ohne Zwischenebene

tack von Marriott. Unsere Engineers arbeiten also mitten im echten Hotelbetrieb, nicht gegen Sandbox-APIs.

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Engineering bei MICE DESK — vollständig. Es gibt keine CTO-Ebene über dir: Architektur, Technik, Delivery und Team liegen bei dir, und du berichtest direkt an die Gründer. Das ist eine Hands-on-Führungsrolle. Du führst das Engineering-Team inklusive unserer AI-/Data-Funktion, verantwortest die Schnittstelle zu Product und stehst für alles gerade, was ausgeliefert wird.


  • Engineering, end-to-end. Architektur, System-Design, Delivery gegen die Roadmap, Zuverlässigkeit, technische Schuld. Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA und das AI-/Data-Team laufen bei dir zusammen. Du setzt schlanke Prozesse, mit denen ein kleines Team schnell liefert, ohne Dinge zu zerbrechen.
  • Eine AI-gestützte Engineering-Pipeline. Wir bauen nicht nur AI-Produkte — wir bauen mit AI. Du machst die Engineering-Organisation selbst AI-nativ: agentische Coding-Workflows, AI-gestützte Reviews und Tests, Automatisierung von allem Wiederkehrenden. Ein kleines Team soll liefern wie ein dreimal so großes — das wahr zu machen ist dein Job.
  • AI als Kernfähigkeit des Systems. Du architektierst die Integration von LLMs und agentischen Workflows in Produktivsysteme: deterministische Logik kombiniert mit AI-generierten Ergebnissen, mit echter Validierung, Fallbacks und Zuverlässigkeitsstrategien. Der Hotelbetrieb läuft auf unserer Plattform — Nicht-Determinismus ist keine Entschuldigung für Unzuverlässigkeit.
  • Das Team. Einstellen, entwickeln, skalieren. Du übernimmst ein starkes kleines Team und machst daraus eine leistungsstarke Engineering-Organisation mit einer Kultur aus Ownership und Tempo. Auch unsere verteilte Hiring-Strategie über mehrere Standorte hinweg liegt bei dir.
  • Product- und Business-Alignment. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Product. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, vereinfachst Komplexität und verbindest Engineering-Arbeit mit Ergebnissen: Umsatz, Automatisierung, Kundenwirkung. Mit dem US-Markteintritt muss Engineering mit Enterprise-Kunden auf zwei Kontinenten Schritt halten.

Woran wir Erfolg messen:

  • 6 Monate: Delivery ist planbar, die AI-gestützte Dev-Pipeline läuft, und das Team ist um A-Player gewachsen, die du eingestellt hast.
  • 12 Monate: Die Plattform skaliert mit US-Enterprise-Kunden, die Kernsysteme sind zuverlässig und observierbar, und Engineering ist ein Wettbewerbsvorteil — kein Flaschenhals.

Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist volle Verantwortung ohne Netz darüber. Keine CTO-Ebene, die Entscheidungen abnimmt oder abfängt — die Architektur, das Team und alles, was ausgeliefert wird, sind deins. Wenn du eine Rolle suchst, in der jemand über dir die Richtung vorgibt, ist das nicht deine Stelle. Wenn du genau diese Verantwortung willst, ist es die richtige.


Dein Profil

  • 10+ Jahre Software Engineering, davon 5+ in einer Engineering-Führungsrolle in wachstumsstarken Produktunternehmen.
  • Starker Hands-on-Hintergrund in Backend oder Full-Stack — du kannst noch selbst in die Tiefe gehen.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung, Engineering-Teams in wachsenden Startups zu skalieren.
  • Starke Architektur-Expertise: APIs, verteilte Systeme, Event-Driven Design, Cloud.
  • LLM-/agentische AI-Systeme in Produktion — und eine echte Überzeugung, dass Engineering selbst AI-gestützt gehört.
  • Product-Mindset: Du verbindest technische Entscheidungen mit geschäftlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Souverän im Umgang mit Ambiguität, Tempo und voller Verantwortung.

Ein Pluspunkt, kein Muss: Hintergrund in Hospitality-Tech, CRM, PMS oder Revenue Management. Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integrationen (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Erfahrung in der Führung verteilter, internationaler Teams.


Warum wir?

Wir sind das Technologieunternehmen, das den Gruppen- und Veranstaltungsverkauf in der Hotellerie neu denkt. Was heute über Posteingang, Excel und Telefon läuft, macht unsere Plattform Rocket zu einem durchgängigen, KI-gestützten Prozess — von der ersten Anfrage bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Europäische Hotelgruppen führen ihren Gruppenverkauf bereits darüber.
Das bedeutet für dich: Du arbeitest nicht trotz KI, sondern mit ihr. Wer bei uns anfängt, gibt Feedback, das in Produktentscheidungen einfließt — und versteht irgendwann, warum ein Prompt besser funktioniert als ein anderer.
Und weil wir schnell wachsen, ist vieles bei uns noch im Entstehen. Manche Antwort lautet ehrlicherweise „das bauen wir gerade noch”. Genau darin liegt die Chance: Du triffst auf Freiräume statt auf fertige Strukturen, und was du hier aufbaust, trägt deine Handschrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Arbeit mit echter KI-Technologie auf internationalem Niveau — nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Geschäftsmodell.
  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einem Ideenbriefkasten, sondern in der nächsten Iteration.
  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Gremienschleifen.
  • Wachstum, das du mitgehst. Wir bauen gerade die nächste Unternehmensphase — mit Rollen, Verantwortung und Perspektiven, die es vor einem Jahr noch nicht gab.
  • Hauptarbeitsort Leipzig mit regelmäßiger Büropräsenz und flexiblem Homeoffice-Anteil. Hybride Modelle sind bei uns gelebte Praxis, nicht die Ausnahme.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, Vollzeit.
  • Leistungsprämien für nachweisbare Erfolge.
  • Mehrtägige Teamevents an Orten, die tatsächlich Spaß machen.
So läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess
  1. Intro-Interview — wir lernen uns kennen, du erfährst, wo wir stehen und wohin wir wollen.
  2. Leadership Study oder Technical Study, je nach Rolle — ein echtes Problem aus unserem Alltag, das wir gemeinsam durchgehen.
  3. Founder Interview

title: Fullstack Developer – AI & LLM (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bauen einen KI-Lernbegleiter für Kinder – und suchen die Person, die ihn technisch verantwortet.

Über 60.000 Kinder und Jugendliche lernen bei uns mit 1:1-Mentoring, Tutoring und Live-Kursen. Was heute Menschen leisten – erkennen, wo ein Kind hängt, im richtigen Moment nachfragen, die passende Übung anbieten – soll künftig ein LLM-basiertes System unterstützen. Nicht als Chatbot mit Bildungsanstrich, sondern als proaktiver Lernbegleiter, der den Lernstand versteht, kindgerecht kommuniziert und an eine echte Pädagogik angebunden ist.

Das Ganze läuft als dreijähriges Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekt, gefördert durch die Investitionsbank Berlin im Programm ProFIT Berlin. Du bekommst also etwas, das in Produktteams selten ist: Zeit und Budget, um Dinge richtig zu bauen – mit dem Anspruch, dass am Ende ein Produkt in Kinderhänden läuft.

Deine Mission

Du entwirfst und baust die LLM-Architektur hinter dem Lernbegleiter für cleverly und complori: Retrieval über kindbezogene Lernprofile und Kursinhalte, proaktive Kommunikationsauslösung und die Echtzeit-Generierung von Mikrolerninhalten. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO, einem Entwickler:innen (React/Node.js bzw. .NET/Angular), dem Head of Product und der pädagogischen Leitung zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

• LLM-Architektur entwerfen und aufbauen – Orchestrierung, RAG über Lernprofile und Kursinhalte, proaktive Trigger, strukturierte Ausgaben (Quizze, Lückentexte, Multiple Choice)

• Kontext-Pipeline bauen – Aufbereitung und Vektorisierung heterogener Daten (Kursmaterialien, Interaktionsdaten, Coach-Feedback, Konversationsverläufe) in Postgres/pgvector

• Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung – Eval-Frameworks für Groundedness, kindgerechte Sprache und pädagogische Angemessenheit, inklusive Guardrails und Eskalationswegen zu menschlichen Coaches

• Datenschutz by Design – DSGVO-konforme Verarbeitung sensibler Daten von Minderjährigen, Auswahl und Betrieb von Modellen auf EU-Infrastruktur bzw. in deutschen Rechenzentren

• Produktintegration – Anbindung der KI-Komponenten an unsere bestehende Plattform über REST-APIs, gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam

• Technologieevaluation – strukturierte Bewertung von Modellen und Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, DSPy). Wir setzen auf moderne, bewährte Werkzeuge statt auf das Fine-Tuning von Basismodellen.

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• 3–5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Python, nodejs oder C#

• Produktionserfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen – RAG-Pipelines (Embedding-Auswahl, Chunking, Hybrid Search, Re-Ranking), Agenten-Orchestrierung und/oder Prompt- und Pipeline-Optimierung

• Erfahrung mit LLM-Evaluation – Offline-Eval-Sets, Metriken für Faktentreue und Relevanz, Guardrails. Das ist für uns das wichtigste Einzelkriterium: Wir brauchen jemanden, der belegen kann, dass das System besser wird, statt es nur zu behaupten.

• Solide Kenntnisse in SQL und relationalen Datenbanken; Erfahrung mit Vektordatenbanken (idealerweise pgvector) und mit nicht-relationalen Datenbanken

• Strukturierte, dokumentierte Arbeitsweise und Lust auf ein kleines Team mit hohem Anspruch

• Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse – ein großer Teil unserer Inhalte und der Zusammenarbeit ist deutschsprachig

• Ein Herz für unsere Vision und Mission – Begeisterung für das Thema Bildung von Kindern/Heranwachsenden

Nice to have

• Erfahrung mit selbst gehosteter Modellinferenz (z. B. vLLM, TGI) und Linux-Server-Administration

• Grundverständnis von Node.js oder C#/.NET, um Integrationsstellen mitzudenken

• Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen, insbesondere DSGVO und Verarbeitung von Kinderdaten

• Affinität zu Bildung und EdTech – oder schlicht eigene Kinder, die dir zeigen, wie Lernen wirklich funktioniert

• Erfahrung mit A/B-Testing und ereignisbasierter Analytik

Unser Tech-Stack

• Plattform: Node.js/React (complori), .NET/Angular (cleverly), AzureDB/Firebase

• KI-Komponenten (dein Bereich): Python, RAG auf pgvector, agentenbasierte Orchestrierung, strukturierte Ausgaben, Eval-Pipelines

• Infrastruktur: Cloud-Hosting mit Fokus auf EU- und DE-Rechenzentren, CI/CD, Monitoring

Was wir bieten

• Transparente Vergütung: bis zu6.600 € brutto im Monat (79.200 € im Jahr), unbefristet und in Vollzeit

• Ein Forschungsprojekt mit Produktanspruch: drei Jahre gefördert durch die IBB, mit klarem Auftrag, echte Fragen zu beantworten statt Features abzuarbeiten

• Technische Entscheidungshoheit: Du baust den KI-Layer von Grund auf – Architektur, Toolwahl und Evaluationsstrategie liegen bei dir

• Wirkung, die man erklären kann: 60.000 Kinder, ein Produkt, das Familien tatsächlich nutzen

• Mentoring für deine eigenen Kinder – unser Produkt steht dem Team offen

Arbeitsort

Berlin, hybrid mit mindestens 3 Tagen pro Woche im Büro. Weil die Stelle über ein Förderprojekt der Investitionsbank Berlin finanziert wird, ist die Tätigkeit am Berliner Standort Voraussetzung – vollständig remote ist leider nicht möglich. Das sagen wir lieber jetzt als im dritten Gespräch.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil – ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Nenn uns stattdessen in ein paar Sätzen ein LLM-System, das du in Produktion gebracht hast, und wie du gemessen hast, ob es gut ist.

Der Prozess: Kennenlernen mit unserem CTO (30 Min) → fachliches Gespräch anhand eines realen Problems aus unserem Projekt (60–90 Min, keine Hausaufgabe über Nacht) → Team- und Kulturgespräch → Angebot. Wir melden uns innerhalb von fünf Werktagen.

At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond.

  • Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making.

Deine Rolle & Wie wir arbeiten

Als unser (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/w/d) verantwortest du wichtige Teile der Rechtsfunktion von BIT Capital und bist die erste Adresse für alle (aufsichts-) rechtlichen Fragen. Als von der BaFin beaufsichtigtes Institut bewegen wir uns in einem dicht regulierten Umfeld, welches bestimmt, wie wir Produkte auflegen, Portfolios steuern und mit unseren Investoren kommunizieren. Du übersetzt diese Anforderungen in Entscheidungen, die unsere Fachbereiche tatsächlich anwenden können. Du berichtest direkt an Dr. Matthias Thom (Managing Director) und arbeitest in einem schlanken Set-up mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

In deiner Rolle fokussierst du dich auf:

  • Aufsichtsrecht. Du berätst unsere Fachbereiche eigenständig in allen aufsichtsrechtlichen Fragestellungen (WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp, GwG, DORA) und entwickelst unser Internes Kontroll- und Compliance-Management-System in der täglichen Anwendung weiter.
  • Erste Adresse im Haus. Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für Portfolio Management, Investment Operations, Sales, Marketing und HR und gibst pragmatische Handlungsempfehlungen statt Gutachten mit offenem Ausgang.
  • Prüfungen & Behördenkontakt. Du koordinierst in- und externe Prüfungen, führst die Kommunikation mit BaFin sowie Bundesbank und steuerst externe Kanzleien und Berater dort, wo wir spezialisierte Unterstützung brauchen.
  • Regulatorische Funktionen. Du übernimmst regulatorische Mandate, insbesondere die Rolle des stellvertretenden Geldwäschebeauftragten (Deputy MLRO) und des Datenschutzbeauftragten.
  • Neue Produkte & strategische Projekte. Du begleitest die Auflage neuer Fonds mit Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften und Depotbanken sowie unsere internationale Expansion rechtlich von der Struktur bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Verträge, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht. Du verantwortest das Vertragswesen und berätst in den weiteren Rechtsgebieten, die ein wachsender Asset Manager täglich berührt.


Deine Erfahrung

  • Zwei juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Aufsichtsrecht für Finanzinstitute, erworben in einer Großkanzlei, einer renommierten Boutique oder in-house bei einem regulierten Institut.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken: WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp und GwG.
  • Belastbare Kenntnisse in weiteren Rechtsgebieten, insbesondere Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht.
  • Du erfasst komplexe aufsichtsrechtliche Sachverhalte schnell, entscheidest eigenständig und begleitest die Umsetzung federführend.
  • Bereitschaft, regulatorische Funktionen persönlich zu übernehmen und die damit verbundene Verantwortung zu tragen.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.


2 Gründe dich nicht zu bewerben

  • Du möchtest dich auf ein einzelnes Rechtsgebiet spezialisieren? Diese Rolle ist bewusst generalistisch angelegt: Neben dem aufsichtsrechtlichen Schwerpunkt liegen Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht ebenfalls bei dir.
  • Du arbeitest lieber im Kanzlei-Set-up mit Zuarbeit und mehreren Prüfschleifen? Bei uns bist du die Rechtsfunktion und triffst Entscheidungen selbst. Wir bieten dir dafür viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, unter anderem beim Aufbau einer Junior-Position an deiner Seite.


Dein Mindset

  • Du besitzt eine Leidenschaft für Aktien, Finanzmärkte und Technologie.
  • Du verstehst Regulatorik als Fundament einer gesunden Organisation und nicht als Bremse. Du sagst klar, was geht, was nicht geht und unter welchen Bedingungen.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag und denkst in deinem eigenen Aufgabengebiet konsequent an Automatisierung.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Ein reines 9-to-5-Mindset passt nicht zu dieser Rolle.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Maßgebliche Verantwortung für die Rechtsfunktion eines wachsenden, BaFin-beaufsichtigten Asset Managers: Du gestaltest, statt zu verwalten.
  • Direkte Berichtslinie an Dr. Matthias Thom (Managing Director) und kurze Entscheidungswege in einem Team von 45+ Kolleg:innen aus 15 Nationen.

Deine Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du unsere Kunden dabei, datengetriebene Lösungen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Du verbindest fachliche Fragestellungen mit modernen Technologien, arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Consultants zusammen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung in unseren Projekten.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Lösungen im Bereich Data & Analytics – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung.
  • Du analysierst Daten, Prozesse und fachliche Anforderungen und hilfst dabei, daraus passende technische Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Consultants an Datenplattformen, Data Warehouses und Analytics-Lösungen und baust dabei kontinuierlich dein Know-how aus.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Datenmodellen, Datenpipelines und Reports sowie bei der Aufbereitung und Visualisierung von Daten.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit Künstlicher Intelligenz und modernen AI-Lösungen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von KI-Agenten und intelligenten Automatisierungslösungen.
  • Du setzt moderne Technologien und Tools wie Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Azure, SQL, Snowflake oder Databricks ein und lernst deren Einsatz in realen Kundenprojekten kennen.
  • Du wirkst bei der Aufnahme und Strukturierung von Anforderungen mit und unterstützt dabei, zwischen fachlichen und technischen Fragestellungen zu vermitteln.
  • Du arbeitest in agilen Projektteams, beispielsweise nach PRINCE2, und bringst dich aktiv in Workshops, Meetings und die gemeinsame Lösungsentwicklung ein.
  • Du übernimmst mit zunehmender Erfahrung eigene Aufgabenpakete und erste Verantwortung innerhalb unserer Projekte.
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung in Kundenprojekten zu übernehmen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden und Kolleg*innen zusammen und bringst dabei deine Hands-on-Mentalität, Neugier und eigenen Ideen ein.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung – oder stehst kurz vor deinem Abschluss.
  • Du interessierst dich für IT, Daten, moderne Technologien und Künstliche Intelligenz und hast Spaß daran, fachliche Herausforderungen mit technischen Lösungen zu verbinden.
  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit SQL, Power BI, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Data Engineering oder Datenanalyse sind von Vorteil – wichtiger ist uns deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit KI, Generative AI oder KI-Agenten sind ein Plus – wichtiger ist uns deine Neugier und Bereitschaft, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.
  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert und hast Freude daran, dich in komplexe Fragestellungen einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bringst Eigeninitiative und Hands-on-Mentalität mit und hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg*innen Kundenprojekte voranzutreiben.
  • Du möchtest dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung in Projekten übernehmen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Eine moderate Reisebereitschaft für unsere Kundenprojekte bringst du mit.


Unser Angebot

  • Gestalte Veränderung mit: Du kommst zu einem spannenden Zeitpunkt zu uns und hast die Möglichkeit, einen wegweisenden Veränderungsprozess aktiv mitzugestalten – mit viel Raum für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
  • Faire & attraktive Vergütung: Wir bieten dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket, das deine Qualifikation, Erfahrung und deinen Verantwortungsbereich berücksichtigt.
  • Learning & Development: Mit der pmOne Academy begleiten wir dich von Anfang an mit einem individuellen Lernpfad und einem persönlichen L&D-Coach. Dazu kommen vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Hybrid Work: Arbeite flexibel im Homeoffice und nutzen unser modern, zentral gelegenes Office für persönlichen Austausch und Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Workation: Du möchtest Arbeit und Tapetenwechsel verbinden? Für einige Wochen im Jahr kannst du mobil aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten – auf Wunsch auch in Kombination mit deinem Urlaub.
  • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Deine Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Wir unterstützen dein physisches und mentales Wohlbefinden unter anderem mit Zugang zu psychologischer Beratung und Coaching sowie einer großzügigen Bezuschussung sportlicher Aktivitäten.
  • Come as you are: Bei uns zählt der Mensch. Wir leben eine wertschätzende und offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und gelebter Diversity.
  • Family first & gemeinsam Spaß haben: Beruf und Privatleben sollen zusammenpassen. Deshalb finden wir bei persönlichen oder familiären Anliegen individuelle Lösungen. Und natürlich kommt auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz – bei Firmenevents, gemeinsamen Koch-Aktivitäten, in der Kaffeeküche oder einfach beim Feierabend mit dem Team.

title: (Senior) Financial Analyst (m/w/d) – CFO Office
description:
Über die Prokuras Gruppe

Prokuras ist eine deutschlandweit agierende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich des Immobilien- und Gebäudemanagements. Bundesweit gehören inzwischen mehr als 500 Mitarbeitende zu den Unternehmen der Prokuras Gruppe. Seit Gründung im Jahr 2023 sind wir durch die Umsetzung von Nachfolgesituation und Wachstumspartnerschaften im Zuge unserer Buy-and-Build Strategie stetig gewachsen.

Als in der Hansestadt Hamburg ansässige Holding-Gesellschaft unterstützen wir unsere Tochterunternehmer und Mitarbeiter bei der Bewältigung ihrer alltäglichen großen wie auch kleinen Herausforderungen. Unser modernes Büro direkt neben den Hamburger Deichtorhallen vis-a-vis zur Hafencity bietet dir ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Du dich wohlfühlen und dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Gleichzeitig leben wir „New Work“: Dein Arbeitsplatz bei uns ist digital – das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice gar kein Problem!

Um das Wachstum unserer Unternehmensgruppe gezielt zu steuern und weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten (Senior) Financial Analyst (m/w/d).

Funktion und Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Reporting & Planung: Du entwickelst unser gruppenweites Reporting weiter und unterstützt bei der rollierenden Finanz- und Unternehmensplanung für unsere Gesellschaften und Investoren.
  • Unternehmensanalyse: Du analysierst Geschäftsmodelle, Ergebnisentwicklungen und finanzielle Kennzahlen, identifizierst wesentliche Werttreiber und leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Business Partnering: Du arbeitest eng mit den Geschäftsführern unserer operativen Gesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt sie als betriebswirtschaftlicher Sparringspartner bei wichtigen Entscheidungen.
  • Controlling & Performance Management: Du schaffst Transparenz über die finanzielle und operative Entwicklung unserer Gesellschaften und entwickelst relevante Steuerungskennzahlen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Performance & Value Creation: Du analysierst Profitabilität, Cashflow, Working Capital und weitere wirtschaftliche Treiber, identifizierst Chancen und Risiken und machst Wertsteigerungspotenziale sichtbar.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Du hinterfragst bestehende Accounting- und Controlling-Prozesse, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und treibst deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv voran.
  • Digitalisierung & KI: Du nutzt moderne Tools und KI-gestützte Ansätze, um Analysen, Reporting und Planungsprozesse effizienter und besser zu gestalten.

Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen

  • Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung gesammelt – idealerweise als Associate im Bereich Transaction Advisory oder Financial Due Diligence bzw. bei einem Private Equity oder Venture Capital Investor.
  • Analytische Kompetenz: Du bist es gewohnt, komplexe Finanzdaten und Geschäftsmodelle schnell zu durchdringen, wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge zu analysieren und die wesentlichen Werttreiber eines Unternehmens herauszuarbeiten. Dabei arbeitest du routiniert mit Excel und bereitest deine Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, ein gutes Gespür für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und die Fähigkeit, sowohl auf Details als auch auf das große Ganze zu schauen.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Hohe Eigeninitiative, Lösungsorientierung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit dem Anspruch, Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben, kritisch zu hinterfragen und konkrete Ergebnisse zu liefern.
  • Digitale Affinität: Begeisterung für moderne Technologien, einen sicheren Umgang mit digitalen Tools sowie Interesse am sinnvollen Einsatz von Automatisierung und KI-/AI-Anwendungen.
  • Persönliche Stärke: Kommunikationsstarkes und bodenständiges Auftreten, ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich aufzubereiten und auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick zu behalten.

Leistungen und Benefits

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Profitiere von einer Vielzahl exklusiver Mitarbeiter-Benefits.

title: Product Engineer — Working Student
description:
Working Student - Product Engineer

Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.

As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.

The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.

This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer "what if?" is to build it, you will fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Find the right problem: Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.
  • Shape a focused product slice: Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.
  • Prototype and iterate quickly: Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.
  • Design for different kinds of work:  Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.
  • Think end to end:  If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.
  • Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:  Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Make the learning visible: Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.

You'll be great for this role if

  • Student status. You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.
  • Modern web development skills. You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work all count.
  • Product-minded builder. You care about the user's goal and accessibility, and can turn an ambiguous problem into the simplest useful solution, test it and iterate.
  • Full-stack and AI curiosity. You want to learn how APIs, data and services turn an interface into a reliable product, and can use AI-assisted tools while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Clear, team-first communication. You can explain what you built end to end, make technical choices understandable, ask for input and respond well to feedback.

Nice to have

  • Backend and integration foundations. Some experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, databases, APIs, serverless functions, Supabase, Firebase, AWS or comparable technologies.
  • Identity and data concepts. A basic understanding of OAuth, SSO, permissions or responsible data handling.
  • What we don't expect: years of professional experience, previous Workday knowledge or a perfect first attempt. If you do not tick every box, please apply anyway and show us what you can build, how you think and how you learn.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Android Engineer - Engagement Mission
description:
About the team:

The SuperApp & Web squad sits within the Engagement Mission under SumUp's Run & Grow tribe, and we're responsible for one of the most strategically important surfaces in SumUp's product ecosystem,  the merchant app home screen.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: make every SumUp merchant feel empowered, informed, and engaged every time they open the app. We own the home screen, tools section, and profile & settings across iOS, Android, and Web,  and we build with four core objectives in mind:

  • Activate merchants so they start using SumUp products as early as possible, through a first-class onboarding and first-time user experience
  • Cross-sell & upsell SumUp products to the right merchants at the right time, via smart promotional components
  • Surface insights that help merchants manage and grow their businesses through home screen widgets
  • Enable navigation to the most relevant screens of the app.

The squad is cross-functional and collaborative, made up of iOS, Android, and full-stack engineers, a senior backend engineer, a senior product manager, a senior designer, and an engineering manager. You'll be paired with a senior Android engineer who will support your onboarding and growth, giving you the space to develop your skills while contributing meaningfully from day one. 

 

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain features of the Android SuperApp home screen, including the first-time user experience, home screen widgets, quick actions, customization, tools section, profile & settings, and promotional channels, with guidance from your senior peers
  • Contribute to the Personas initiative, helping build a tailored and customizable home screen experience that reduces friction and surfaces relevant data for each merchant
  • Support codebase modularization and refactoring efforts, learning how to write scalable, maintainable code in a real-world production environment
  • Participate in the definition and refinement of team initiatives, asking good questions, sharing ideas, and growing your technical judgment over time
  • Take part in code reviews as both a contributor and a reviewer, building good habits around clean code and engineering best practices
  • Write clear technical documentation and gradually build confidence communicating with stakeholders across product, design, and engineering
  • Embrace a culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning, this is a place where growth is expected and supported

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Are proficient in Kotlin and have hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose for building Android UIs
  • Have a working knowledge of MVVM, MVP, or similar architectural patterns and understand the value of clean, well-structured code
  • Experience working with large monorepos and building different flavors of Android apps
  • Are comfortable working in evolving codebases and are eager to learn how to navigate complexity and contribute to refactoring efforts
  • Have a genuine UI/UX sensibility,you care about building experiences that feel right, not just code that compiles
  • Are a team player who has worked alongside engineers, product managers, and designers in a cross-functional environment
  • Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset, you ask questions, take initiative, and aren't afraid to say "I don't know yet, but I'll find out"
  • Can communicate your ideas clearly in writing and are willing to build your technical documentation skills over time

Nice to have: 

  • Experience with Firebase, Optimizely, or API design 
  • Experience with Design Systems, motion, or accessibility on Android

About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

  • Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

  • Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers.

  • Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments.

  • Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems.

title: Head EMEA Refund Fraud, Integrity - Fixed Term Contract
description:
About the Role

The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace.

You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers.

This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment.

You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy

    • Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap.

    • Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.

    • Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest.

    • Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls.

    • Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments.

  2. Owning Performance and Risk

    • Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails.

    • Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost.

    • Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions.

    • Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken.

    • Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats.

  3. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities

    • Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys.

    • Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place.

    • Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions.

    • Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails.

    • Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention.

    • Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value.

  4. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment

    • Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams.

    • Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line.

    • Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension.

    • Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus.

    • Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact.

    • Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

  5. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

    • Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals.

    • Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members.

    • Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction.

    • Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks.

    • Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs.

    • Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions.

    • Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring:

  • Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years.

  • Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects.

  • A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon.

  • Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences.

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance.

  • Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions.

  • Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions.

  • Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations.

Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it.

What Success Looks Like

  • In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities.

  • You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities.

  • You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits
